summary: Iteration 8 (Per-Scene Redo, FRONTEND-ONLY) — end-to-end flow validated on Expo web preview @ 390x844 against EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL with REELS_MOCK=1. FULL PASS: (1) Create screen loads; VISUAL STYLE -> AI IMAGES (data-testid=segment-ai) selected and IMAGE STYLE chip row appears (image-style-cinematic default). (2) topic-input filled with 'Three fun facts about octopuses'; generate-reel-button tapped -> router navigates to /reel/{id}. (3) Reel reaches status=ready in ~10.5s under REELS_MOCK=1 (reel-player + video-view render). (4) edit-scenes-button is visible on the ready screen (only for visual_mode='ai') and tapping it navigates to /scenes/{id}. (5) Scenes editor renders 3 scene cards (scene-card-0/1/2), each with an image (Scene 1/2/3 badge), editable prompt TextInput (scene-prompt-{i}) prefilled with the mock prompt ('Mock cinematic vertical scene N for the story'), and a ghost 'Regenerate this scene' button (scene-regen-{i}). scenes-back header button present. (6) Edited scene-prompt-0 to 'A neon octopus glowing in deep dark water, cinematic' and tapped scene-regen-0. (7) scenes-working indicator ('Repainting & re-rendering…' with ActivityIndicator) appeared immediately; image overlay spinner rendered on the affected card only (busyIndex gating works). (8) After ~9s the polling in scenes/[id].tsx picked up status='ready', scenes-working disappeared, image bust query param refreshed, scenes-error was NOT shown, and scene-regen-0 aria-disabled='false' (button re-enabled). (9) scenes-back tapped -> navigated back to /reel/{id} cleanly, no crash/blank. (10) No red screen; only pre-existing web warnings (expo-notifications push token, props.pointerEvents deprecation) — carried over from prior iterations. Test reel 0b3b5129-b62a-41ae-afb3-39750dbb3e82 was cleaned up via DELETE /api/reels/{id} -> {ok:true}.

react_native_issues.issue: Pre-existing React 19 warning `props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents` fires on load. Not introduced this iteration. Reference: carried over from iterations 2-7.
Pre-existing warning `[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web` on load — web-preview limitation, not a Per-Scene Redo issue.

critical_code_review_comments: scenes/[id].tsx:53-66 poll() reuses api.getReel and calls load() only when status transitions to ready/failed — busyIndex clears via load() and image bust timestamp is refreshed so the new image is fetched (cachePolicy='none' on expo-image reinforces this). Clean.

scenes/[id].tsx:68-82 regenerate() correctly guards against concurrent triggers via `busyIndex !== null` and immediately flips status='rendering' before firing the API — this makes the workingBar (line 106) show without waiting for the first poll tick. Good UX.

scenes/[id].tsx:121 sceneImageUrl bust key uses `?t=${bust}` local timestamp — good for forcing image reload after a regenerate; expo-image cachePolicy='none' is set on line 124 as belt-and-suspenders.

scenes/[id].tsx:117-151 uses PrimaryButton with variant='ghost' + `disabled={working || !editable}` — while ANY scene is regenerating, ALL regen buttons on the page are disabled, which is the intended behaviour to prevent parallel regenerate requests.
reel/[id].tsx:355-364 edit-scenes-button correctly gated on `reel?.visual_mode === 'ai'` — will not appear for gradient reels. Verified.
api.ts:139-148 getScenes + regenerateScene + sceneImageUrl are minimal and correctly hit /api/reels/{id}/scenes and /api/reels/{id}/scene/{index}/regenerate. Response type is well-typed.
No blocking issues, no dead code, no test-only workarounds needed for this feature.
